column1: # Explicit verdict cases: the ONE truth table both the iOS app and the bridge test against.
# Byte-identical copies live in both repos; the iOS copy is canonical (change both in one Mirror-PR pair).
# Columns are tab-separated: kind, input (a JSON string), expected.
#   value: a tag field's text value          -> explicit | none
#   rtng:  an MP4 rtng integer (as a string)  -> explicit | none
#   field: a tag FIELD NAME, any container    -> read | ignored
#   title: a RAW track title (tag or filename stem, before display cleaning) -> explicit | none
